title: Underlying-map naturality of descent transport
statement: Let $p:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $V\to X$ a scheme over $X$, and $D$ a transport descent datum [def-pd-descent-datum]. For $g:T'\to T$, maps $f_1,f_2:T\to X$ with equal composites to $Y$, and $a:T\to V$ over $f_1$, let $f_i'=g f_i$ and let $a'$ over $f_1'$ have underlying map $g a$. Then the underlying map of the transport of $a'$ from $f_1'$ to $f_2'$ is $g$ followed by the underlying map of the transport of $a$ from $f_1$ to $f_2$.

source.place: Tag 0H8K, naturality of the cartesian descent datum

proof.text: Substitute the equalities f1'=g f1 and f2'=g f2. Extensionality of Over morphisms identifies a' with Over.homMk g followed by a from the equality of underlying maps. Apply the existing transport_homMk_comp field and project to underlying maps.

lean.statement:
theorem transport_left_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {p : X ⟶ Y} {V : Over X} (D : Over.DescentDatum p V)
    {T T' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ T) (f₁ f₂ : T ⟶ X)
    (h : f₁ ≫ p = f₂ ≫ p) (a : Over.mk f₁ ⟶ V)
    (f₁' f₂' : T' ⟶ X) (h' : f₁' ≫ p = f₂' ≫ p) (a' : Over.mk f₁' ⟶ V)
    (hf₁ : f₁' = g ≫ f₁) (hf₂ : f₂' = g ≫ f₂) (ha : a'.left = g ≫ a.left) :
    (D.transport f₁' f₂' h' a').left = g ≫ (D.transport f₁ f₂ h a).left
